caption: The drawing depicts a single white garment, likely a nightgown or chemise, displayed front-facing and centered on a light, neutral background. The garment is off-white, with short, wide sleeves that are gently gathered at the shoulders and trimmed with a delicate lace or embroidered border. The neckline is wide and rounded, decorated with embroidery or lacework in a symmetrical pattern along the edge and down the shallow V-shaped yoke at the front. The main body of the garment is loose and flowing, with subtle vertical folds and shading suggesting the drape and texture of the fabric. The lower edge is simple and unadorned, curving gently. The drawing is bordered by a faint rectangular outline, and the signature "Jean Paget" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Chemise
